batches.brief: Convert parse_custbill_fixedwidth.sh into the typed table ow_tp.ow_tp_custbill.custbill_records over the feed. Copybook CBCUST01, 65-char records: cust_id X(10) rtrim; cust_name X(30) rtrim (Oracle leg already NFKD-transliterated); bill_date 9(8) YYYYMMDD→DATE, legacy does no digit validation; bill_amt 9(10)V99 implied-decimal→DECIMAL(12,2) (legacy divides by 100); currency X(3); rec_type X(2) (01 invoice / 02 credit). Strip HDR/TRL wrappers. Legacy emits $4=sprintf('%.2f',$4/100) — keep cents→dollars exact. Reads .migration/units/custbill_parse/mapping_spec.json; replay fixtures must include ≥1 rec_type=02 credit (live batch 85559852 has none). Gates: row_parity + typed-field compare vs legacy .psv replay; evidence .migration/recon/custbill_records/.
